integrity: The fresh primary full text was inspected at Theorem 7, the proof of Theorem 2, and the optimized-parallel remark. The all-order gap series, positivity, admissible-parameter asymptotic, and second-parameter expansion were reconstructed independently from the displayed source formulas. The primary Diamond-ensemble theorem was inspected as the closest earlier energy construction. No numerical experiment is used in the proof.
scientific_limitations: The result quantifies the parameter cost inside the Pearl ensemble and does not claim that the Pearl limiting coefficient is the universal optimum for spherical logarithmic energy. The expansion of the second optimized parameter is continuous; no quantitative Diophantine denominator bound for its odd-rational-square approximants is asserted. The energy remainder term is unchanged.
title: Sharp parameter-cost law for approaching the optimal Pearl energy coefficient
